batch: Scene search and rotating conduit forms

scope.seek: One authored collectible conservatory, eight objects, zoom/pan, three non-completing hints.
scope.conduit: Two authored square pipe networks, elbow/straight tiles, rotate/undo, connectivity preview and incremental flow.

seek: Clicked red teapot at overview, blue butterfly at 1.7× after one hint, then all six remaining objects; reached 8/8.
Pause disabled controls; refresh restored 2/8, two hints and zoom; completed 8/8 was also restored.
390px viewport: two-column targets, 46px controls, magnified view and actual drag pan inspected.
Updated fullscreen start/pause overlays align horizontally and vertically to canvas. Resume, overview and hint continue responding. Final independent error log was empty.
conduit: Initial incomplete network ran and showed a real A1 break; returned to edit mode.
Selection, rotation, undo and preview exercised; first stage solved in eight rotations, 11 pipe segments; reached its output.
Second stage selected B1 via mobile control and completed through ordinary clicks in ten rotations, 18 segments; both-stage completion inspected.
Paused during live second-stage flow; two canvas-region PNG captures are byte/pixel identical; reload retained live flow and continued to completed state.
390px viewport: no horizontal overflow; final native controls all 46px minimum; fullscreen and ready start layout inspected. Final independent error log was empty.
compare: Left start followed by right start makes left pause button read 继续 and right read 暂停. Pause overlay remains within scene.
Final normal-session comparison left 0/8 and right stage 1/2, zero rotations, ready to start. Original golf/train tab kept open and not reset.

resolved_findings.finding: Ready button initially sat below scene because overlay spanned scene plus controls.
resolved_findings.fix: New-frame ResizeObserver tracks canvas area; intro and pause layers constrained to its top, left, width and height.

resolved_findings.finding: Conduit mobile rotate label wrapped, undo left an empty half-row.
resolved_findings.fix: Short visible rotate label with descriptive aria-label; full-width mobile undo; native buttons 46px.

resolved_findings.finding: A negative initial RAF delta could turn a zero feedback timer positive while its point was absent, causing seekScreen(null) and a frozen frame.
resolved_findings.fix: New factories normalize finite nonnegative delta; seek draw guards absent feedback; actual negative-tick factory draw regression added and fullscreen native start/pause/resume rechecked.

error_scope.comparison_existing_log: Uncaught TypeError: Failed to execute 'observe' on 'MutationObserver': parameter 1 is not of type 'Node'.
error_scope.note: Same comparison log was present before this batch; source remains unidentified. No error-hiding handler was added. Does not justify a global zero-error claim.

limits: Single room and two short boards; no claim of extensive content or genre exhaustiveness.
Responsive checks use browser viewport simulation, not real mobile hardware/performance.
No audible sound quality review or user playtest performed.
Other existing modules retain their earlier quality records; preservation is not a fresh visual review of all 47 forms.
